name: Charles Hayward Foundation Overseas Grants
summary: One-year grants of up to £15,000 for UK registered charities running projects in Commonwealth Africa. Nature work fits under sustainable livelihoods tied to environmental and wildlife conservation; the water, sanitation and farming-skills strands are outside nature work.

steps: Stage 2 additional financial and project information, if invited

eligibility.rule: Not be newly established without at least one set of annual accounts
Not be an excluded applicant or seek an excluded grant type
Not seek disaster appeals, education, gap years, electives, overseas project visits or overseas disability awareness
Project is in clean water and sanitation, sustainable livelihoods in conservation, or farming skills training
At least 2 years since the last grant payment, if previously funded
At least 1 year since a declination, if previously unsuccessful

documents: List of trustees, if not referenced in accounts
Draft or management accounts, if accounts are over 12 months old

amount.quote: The trustees will fund projects with a one year grant of up to £15,000.

effort.quote: Please submit a proposal (no more than four A4 pages in length) by email to grants@charleshaywardfoundation.org.uk
Applicants that progress to Stage 2 will be asked to submit additional financial and project information as necessary.

eligibility.quote: No, we can only accept applications from UK registered charities.
UK registered charities that have an annual income of between £150,000 and £4,000,000.
We do not accept applications from charities which are newly established and do not have at least one set of annual accounts.

Individuals General appeals Endowments Loans and deficits Academic Institutions Grant-making charities Retrospectively (i.e. costs already incurred prior to receiving a grant offer from the Foundation) Unrestricted grants
Disaster appeals Education Gap years, electives, project visits overseas Overseas disability awareness

We only fund projects in the following sub-categories: Clean water and sanitation. Development of sustainable livelihoods in the context of environmental and wildlife conservation. Self-sustainability through training in farming skills and other income generation activities.
Charities that have previously received a grant must wait at least two years from the date of the last grant payment before re-applying.
Charities that have applied unsuccessfully must wait one year from the date of declination before re-applying.

after_award.quote: We require a report within a year of the grant payment.

documents.quote: one set of your latest accounts
a list of your trustees if these are not referenced in the accounts
If your accounts are more than 12 months old, please provide draft/management accounts for the charity's most recent financial year.
